extractor_notes.blockers: Seer is a proteomics tools / life-sciences research products company (Proteograph Product Suite). 8-K Ex-99.1 filings disclose quarterly earnings, Chief Commercial Officer appointment, and biobank/large-scale contract progress, but contain no clinical-trial or FDA/regulatory product catalysts (no Phase, PDUFA, BLA, NDA, IND, 510(k) language for the company's own products). Confirmed no clinical/regulatory catalysts in 8-K window.
